description.zh: 一个用于 AP 课程选课的 Web 系统，基于 Flask 和 MySQL 构建，已在学校平台使用并获得师生好评。
description.en: A web system for AP course registration built with Flask and MySQL. Now used in school's platforms with positive feedback from users.

description.zh: 家乡的长辈常和我玩这款麻将，我担心它逐渐失去人气，因此尝试做一个在线版本。
description.en: Elders in my hometown used to play this game with me. To preserve its popularity, I'm making an online version.

description.zh: 我用 Cocos 引擎开发的第一款游戏。基于现实物理模拟，控制小鸟穿越管道。
description.en: My first game developed with the Cocos engine. Physics-based gameplay guiding a bird through pipes.

description.zh: 一款网页上的策略模拟游戏，目标是让玩家尽可能细致地管理国家。
description.en: A web-based strategy simulation where players manage a country in detail.

description.zh: 用于练习 Geoguessr/图寻技能的工具，帮助熟悉俄罗斯不同地区街景车天线状态并在地图上准确选择。
description.en: A tool to practice Geoguessr/Tuxun skills. Learn antenna statuses in Russia regions and select accurately on the map.

description.zh: 用于帮助家庭与学校高效规划和管理家访的 Web 应用，支持地址解析、区域聚类、路径优化与可视化展示。
description.en: A web-based application designed to help families and schools efficiently plan and manage home visits with geocoding, clustering, route optimization and visualization.

content.zh: 项目源于一次数学课的“最短路径”任务，同时老师分享了家访规划的痛点：手工标点和规划路线耗时且容易低效。我希望用编程解决真实问题，由此萌生了系统。
content.en: The project started from a math task on shortest paths, and a teacher's real pain: manually marking addresses and planning routes was time-consuming and inefficient. I wanted to solve it with code, and the system idea was born.

content.zh: 随着学校规模扩大、家访增多，仅靠手工难以兼顾距离、分工、交通与集中度等因素。我希望做一个能落地的工具，让老师把时间投入到陪伴与交流上。
content.en: With growing school scale and more visits, manual planning can't balance distance, workload, traffic and clustering. I aimed to build a practical tool so teachers can focus on students and families.

content.zh: 学习使用高德地图 API 获取地址经纬度，编写聚类算法按区域分组，结合路径优化减少往返；大量使用 AI 辅助查阅与调试，最终完成 CSV 输入、自动计算与可视化呈现。
content.en: Used Gaode Maps API for geocoding, implemented clustering to group nearby addresses, and route optimization to reduce travel; leveraged AI for docs and debugging; achieved CSV input, auto-compute and visualization.

content.zh: 后端采用 Flask + MySQL，前端原生 HTML/JS 结合高德地图 JS SDK。核心流程：地址转经纬度 → 数据库写入 → 区域聚类 → 路径排序 → 地图呈现，并部署在云端供老师使用。
content.en: Backend: Flask + MySQL; Frontend: HTML/JS with Gaode Maps JS SDK. Flow: geocoding → DB write → clustering → route ordering → map display; deployed in the cloud for teachers.

content.zh: 老师指导我搭建仓库、撰写文档与日志、管理协作；AI 提供文档链接、调试与优化建议，并协助算法调参和问题定位，提升了迭代效率。
content.en: A teacher guided repo setup, documentation and collaboration; AI helped with docs, debugging, optimization, and algorithm tuning—speeding up iteration.

content.zh: 工程周期长且需持续优化，期间与学业多次冲突。我学习了优先级管理，将关键模块集中攻克，并通过沟通与规划在学业与项目间取得平衡。
content.en: The long development required continuous optimization and clashed with academics. I learned prioritization, focused on key modules, and balanced studies and project through planning and communication.
